description: Change the text color of a block by opening the Text color picker in the editor settings sidebar and clicking the named swatch. Self-selects the target block first; defaults to the first paragraph.
examples: set the paragraph text color to Accent 1
make the heading text color Accent 3
change the text color to Accent 2
set the second paragraph text color to Accent 4
label: Set the {{blockType}} text color to {{colorName}}
